required_statement: A parent Hamiltonian H_parent[tau] exists on the reduced physical phase space after gauge and constraint removal.
why_needed: without reduced phase space, negative gauge directions can be mistaken for physical ghosts

required_statement: The quadratic kinetic form K_IJ on all propagating non-gauge modes is positive semidefinite, and positive definite off gauge/constraint directions.
why_needed: wrong-sign kinetic terms create ghost energy and destroy the DEC shortcut

required_statement: The local parent action is second-order or degenerate/constraint-owned so no independent higher-time-derivative ghost remains.
why_needed: higher-derivative nondegenerate terms make the Hamiltonian unbounded below

required_statement: V_eff(Phi) is bounded below on the local branch and Hessian/mass matrix is nonnegative, with positive mass gap for source-free extra modes.
why_needed: tachyonic/sign-indefinite Hessian gives local hair and negative sectors

required_statement: C(Phi)R, boundary improvements, counterterms and regularization terms are double-zero/topological or have a bounded energy contribution.
why_needed: nonminimal terms can move energy between bulk and boundary and fake positivity

required_statement: The same parent action whose Hamiltonian is bounded below defines the Hilbert source T_total(n,tau) used in M_EH.
why_needed: a positive canonical Hamiltonian does not help if the source stress is a different object

required_statement: Boundary/reference terms are fixed, source-blind, and do not add negative wall energy beyond epsilon_closed.
why_needed: negative boundary or reference energy can invalidate source positivity

required_statement: If HNC3948_0..6 hold and source support is nonzero, then Z_energy_condition can be signed for the local total Hilbert source.
why_needed: this is the clean derivation path for M_EH>0
